# https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud

This section covers the day-to-day management of a SurrealDB Cloud deployment. If you are setting up Cloud for the first time, start with the [getting started guide](https://surrealdb.com/docs/build/deployment/surrealdb-cloud/getting-started) and [connecting](https://surrealdb.com/docs/build/deployment/surrealdb-cloud/connecting) pages instead.
##  Cloud plans[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud#cloud-plans)
SurrealDB Cloud offers managed deployments from development through production-scale clusters:  
| Plan  | Topology  | Storage  | Best for  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  **Start** (incl. free tier)  | Single-node  | Dedicated storage per instance  | Development, staging, and workloads that scale vertically  |  
| **Scale**  | Multi-node cluster (min. three compute units)  |  [SurrealDS](https://surrealdb.com/platform/surrealds) distributed storage  | Business-critical production that must survive node failure  |  
For diagrams and how Start and Scale differ in practice, see [Cloud architecture](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/architecture). For operational detail, see [High availability](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/high-availability) and [Scaling](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/scaling). For pricing, see [surrealdb.com/pricing](https://surrealdb.com/pricing).
##  Management topics[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud#management-topics)
Topics covered here include:
  * •
[Architecture](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/architecture) — Start vs Scale topologies and how Cloud maps to SurrealDS.
  * •
[Instance management](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/instance-management) — creating, pausing, resuming, and deleting instances.
  * •
[Scaling](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/scaling) — adjusting compute and storage to match your workload.
  * •
[High availability](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/high-availability) — fault tolerance on Start vs Scale plans.
  * •
[Network access](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/network-access) — IP allowlisting, VPC peering, and PrivateLink configuration.
  * •
[Backups & recovery](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/backups-and-recovery) — automated snapshots, retention policy, and in-platform restore.
  * •
[Monitoring & logs](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/monitoring-and-logs) — dashboards, metrics, and log access.
  * •
[Patches & upgrades](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/patches-and-upgrades) — changing the SurrealDB version on Cloud instances.
  * •
[Organisations & users](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/organisations-and-users) — team management, roles, and invitations.
  * •
[Billing & support](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/billing-and-support) — plans, invoices, and support channels.
  * •
[AWS Marketplace](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud/aws-marketplace) — subscribing to SurrealDB Cloud through AWS Marketplace.
